description: Na₆BeO₄ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃mc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (2.32 Å) and three longer (2.39 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.53 Å. Be is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (1.70 Å) and three longer (1.76 Å) Be-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven Na and one Be atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to six Na and one Be atom.
